words: Love Nov 5 2026 5:52 PM PT: "omg the stats page was supposed to be scoring the whole day babez 😹it still hasn’t moved" / 5:54 PM PT: "no i want it to score for the week if possible bb , and keep the older ones in the view only archive so it doesn’t slow her down"
what: fix767 STATS BY THE WEEK (display only): the STATS 'ALL TIME' box was really the last 4 days of this paper book's fills, rolling (720 trades, 360W/360L, -$796.61 matched to the cent), so a new day barely moved it. Adds THIS WEEK above it (Monday 12:00 AM Pacific, scored on her side, one row per setup sent to the page) and an ARCHIVE button: each finished week is kept in data/stats-weeks/<monday>.json and is read only when you open it. The old box is relabelled LAST 4 DAYS. No entries, exits, walls or books touched.
